Analytical and results-driven Business Analyst with over 10.9 years of experience in the banking and financial services sector. Proven ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions, streamline operations, and deliver data-driven insights. Experienced in regulatory compliance, core banking systems, financial products, and process optimization. Proven expertise in Avaloq, analyzing, designing, and optimizing payment systems including SWIFT, SEPA, FPS, CHAPS, BACS, and ISO 20022 messaging. Skilled in requirements gathering, Vendor and Stakeholder management, and driving digital transformation across cross-border and domestic payments. Adapt at working in Agile and Waterfall environments and collaborating across business, IT, Risk, Regulatory and compliance teams
 • Holding 10.9 years of experience as Business Analyst - KYC Account opening, AML/KYC, Customer Screening, Fraud Investigation, Transaction Monitoring, End to End Corporate KYC in FCC Operations, Risk and compliance, ATM Operations, Account Maintenance, Sanctions screening, Correspondent Banking, Swift Payments. 
Compatible in team environment and strive to achieve the target with hard work and sincerity.
• • • • Good Training and Development communication skills. • Willingness to relocate and ability to quickly adapt to new environments & technologies.

Experience Details
Worked as an AML Investigation Executive – FCC OPS with HSBC, Visakhapatnam, from May 2015 till November 2016.
Worked as Investigative Business Analyst –with WNS Global services, Bangalore, from November 2016 till October 2017.
Worked as Senior Practitioner- BA, Risk and Compliance Team at IBM INDIA Pvt Ltd, Bangalore, from November 2017 till May 2019 (Internal movement from WNS).
Worked as Senior Associate - BA in the process of KYC Account opening under Retail Operations Banking with Mashreq Global Services, Bangalore from July 2019 till Dec 2020.
Worked as Senior Associate - BA in the process of Wealth Management - PB Operations, End-to-End KYC on corporate customers with Deutsche Bank, Bangalore from December 2020 till August 2022.
Working as Lead- BA, Correspondent banking, Private Banking operations, with Mashreq Global Services, Bangalore from August 2022 till 13th Feb 2026.
Job Profile
Mashreq Global Services, Bangalore, India Lead – CBTM, Private Banking operations
Aug 2022 – 13th Feb26
Gathered and analyzed business and regulatory requirements by working closely with Business Users,
Operations, Compliance, and Risk teams.
Understanding CBTM scenarios, rules, and thresholds,Gather requirements for Customer risk profiling,
Transaction monitoring rules, Alert generation & escalation.
Define functional specifications for Scenario tuning, Risk scoring models, Alert workflows, Support
scenario calibration & optimization
Gathered and documented business requirements for enhancing SWIFT payment investigation workflows

in the CBTM domain. Supported implementation of automated investigation tools integrating GPI Tracker and real-time exception management features.
Worked closely with operations teams to streamline exception handling processes, reducing investigation
turnaround time by 30%.
Analyzed trends in failed and delayed SWIFT messages to provide insights for process improvement and
• • •
reduce operational risk. Prepared BRDs, FRS, process flows, and use-case documentation. Created UAT scenarios, test cases, and defect reports. Supported regulatory submissions, audit responses, and compliance attestations. Participated in UAT for CBTM system enhancements involving message parsing, payment tracking, and case management modules.
Designed reporting dashboards to monitor investigation KPIs (e.g., resolution time, root causes,



recurrence rate). Participate in false-positive reduction initiatives, Assist compliance teams during audits & regulatory reviews Conducted gap analysis on current credit approval processes; proposed automation strategies that cut manual effort by 30%. Facilitated workshops with stakeholders to define KPIs for credit risk monitoring and designed dashboards using Power BI.
Deutsche Bank, Bangalore, India Dec 2020 – Aug 2022 Senior Associate, Wealth Management - PB Operations, End to End KYC Process
Gathered and documented business and functional requirements for KYC onboarding and periodic review
processes across corporate and retail banking segments.
Mapped end-to-end KYC workflows, identifying gaps and inefficiencies in customer due diligence (CDD),
enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk rating logic.
Worked with compliance teams to translate regulatory requirements (e.g., AMLD5, FATF, FinCEN) into
actionable system and process enhancements.
Designed future-state KYC operating models and workflows (BPMN) to improve turnaround time and

reduce manual intervention by 30%. Led impact assessments and root cause analysis for KYC delays, driving remediation actions and policy updates.
Developed process maps and SOPs for onboarding high-risk customers, including beneficial ownership,


PEP checks, and adverse media screening. Supported the implementation of a centralized KYC platform (e.g., Fenergo, Actimize, internal system) to streamline onboarding and periodic reviews. Coordinated UAT planning and execution for KYC modules, including client risk scoring, document verification, and case management.
Worked closely with developers and data teams to implement rule-based logic for customer classification
and risk tiering.
Gathered and analyzed business requirements for wealth management products including portfolio


management, discretionary mandates, and advisory services within the Avaloq Core Banking system. Configured and customized Avaloq objects, parameters, and workflows to support private banking operations such as client onboarding, KYC, risk profiling, and investment lifecycle management. Collaborated with relationship managers, portfolio managers, and compliance teams to design solutions aligned with private banking business processes and regulatory requirements.
Worked extensively on Avaloq Data Dictionary (DDIC) for data mapping, data lineage, and ensuring
accurate data definitions across modules.
Designed and documented BRD, FRD, and process flow diagrams for wealth management functionalities








including portfolio rebalancing, trade lifecycle, and corporate actions. Supported implementation of investment products such as equities, fixed income, structured products, mutual funds, and derivatives within Avaloq. Configured and maintained Avaloq workflows and rule engines for automated processing of trades, settlements, and client reporting. Integrated Avaloq with external systems using Avaloq Messaging Interface (AMI), APIs, and web services for payments, market data feeds, and third-party platforms. Supported end-to-end trade lifecycle: order capture, execution, allocation, settlement, and post-trade reporting. Performed data analysis using SQL to validate transactions, troubleshoot issues, and ensure data consistency across systems. Participated in UAT (User Acceptance Testing), SIT, and regression testing; created test cases and ensured business scenarios are covered. Identified and resolved production issues, performed root cause analysis, and coordinated with IT teams for quick resolution. Ensed compliance with regulatory frameworks such as MiFID II, KYC/AML, and FATCA in private banking processes.
Generated client reports using Avaloq Report Writer, including portfolio performance, valuation, and risk
analysis reports.
Worked in Agile/Scrum environment, using tools like Jira and Confluence for backlog management, sprint
planning, and documentation.
